scope.claim: Test whether one fixed balanced FP32 reduction can carry a small online state that yields a useful rigorous reduction-error envelope and a calibrated statistical error interval / correctly-rounded probability.
scope.motivation: Per-input tree selection was scientifically predictive but required 68 score-side traversals. This stage performs no candidate-tree search: it annotates the one reduction that is executed.
not_claimed: a guarantee from the Gaussian interval
coverage outside the frozen wide-range calibration distribution

data_boundary.stopping_rule: run every frozen group once; do not add groups in response to results
data_boundary.confirmation_rule: no fresh confirmation split may be generated or opened in this stage

execution_contract.leaf_domain: positive finite values already stored exactly as binary32
execution_contract.trajectory: one FP32 result per internal node; no candidate-tree replay or search
execution_contract.cheap_side: nonnegative FP32 bit patterns, exponent extraction, integer-aligned operand addition for exactness detection, fixed-size scalar state, and normal-CDF evaluation
execution_contract.label_side: Fraction oracle is isolated to calibration labels and invariant checks

online_state.result: s: rounded binary32 subtree sum bits
online_state.corr4_all: Qcorr4_all adds 2*rho_gap*U_v*U_a/12 for ancestor pairs at gaps 1..4
online_state.corr4_inexact: Qcorr4_inexact applies the same kernel only when both endpoint additions are inexact
online_state.kernel_warning: The kernel came from standardized history correlation, not a proved local-residual covariance law; corr4 quantities are exploratory, not bounds.
online_state.exactness_warning: Detecting exact additions is cheaper than tree enumeration but is not free; the diagnostic must report this cost contract explicitly.

frozen_variance_proxies.no_posthoc_proxy: No new maintained quantity may be promoted using these 192 target labels; additional quantities require a new calibration version.

cross_fitting.fold_assignment: input index modulo 5 within every width
cross_fitting.zero_mean_model: E/sqrt(Q) ~ Normal(0, c^2), with c^2 = mean(E^2/Q) on the other four folds
cross_fitting.bias_aware_model: E/sqrt(Q) ~ Normal(beta, c^2), with beta and population variance fitted on the other four folds
cross_fitting.reason: Cross-fitting prevents each reported interval from using its own error label while keeping this explicitly calibration-only.

rounding_cell_probability.error_sign: E = computed FP32 root minus exact stored-leaf sum
rounding_cell_probability.safe_cell: derive the lower and upper midpoint boundaries from the adjacent positive finite binary32 values around the computed root
rounding_cell_probability.formula: P_safe = Phi((b-mu)/sigma) - Phi((a-mu)/sigma), where (a,b) is the root-error interval that rounds to the computed root
rounding_cell_probability.tie_note: Boundary inclusivity affects exact midpoint atoms but not the continuous Gaussian integral; observed correctness still uses exact ties-to-even labels.

hard_invariants: computed root bits equal the exact graph oracle
absolute root error is no greater than B_all and B_inexact for every group
gaussian_shape: cross-fitted standardized mean, standard deviation, skew, excess kurtosis, KS distance to standard normal
absolute standardized p90, p99, and maximum
pooled and per-width two-sided interval coverage at 90%, 99%, and 99.9%
probability_quality: certification coverage and observed precision at P_safe thresholds 0.90 and 0.99
rigorous_bound_quality: fraction for which the rigorous interval lies strictly inside the computed root rounding cell
macro_diagnostics: maximum-leaf/root ratio and effective leaf count

interpretation_rules.implementation_stop: Any hard-invariant failure invalidates the run and blocks interpretation.
interpretation_rules.gaussian_viability: For the primary cross-fitted model, pooled coverage must be at least 0.88 at nominal 90% and 0.98 at nominal 99%; every width must reach at least 0.85 and 0.95 respectively; absolute-Z p99 must not exceed 3.5.
interpretation_rules.probability_usefulness: P_safe must improve Brier score over the cross-fitted prevalence baseline and either certify at least 10% of groups at threshold 0.90 with observed precision at least 0.90 or expose a useful lower-confidence risk gradient. Otherwise it is descriptive only.
interpretation_rules.rigorous_certificate: B is a deployable certificate only if its derivation remains valid and its strict rounding-cell certification rate is nonzero; looseness must be reported even when coverage is perfect.
interpretation_rules.failure_path: If normal tails or width stability fail, do not repair this run post hoc; the next candidate may use empirical/conformal quantiles, Student-t tails, or a separately frozen width/macro inflation law.
interpretation_rules.success_path: A passing calibration authorizes only a separately preregistered confirmation stage; it is not itself held-out evidence.

artifacts.overwrite: forbidden; any existing complete or partial directory blocks execution
